meaning:
Charashim or Harashim = "valley of craftsmen"
a valley near Lydda, a few miles east of Joppa, founded by Joab of Othniel's family
Combined with gay (גַּיְא "Ge" H1516K)

elsewhere.note: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim; for they were craftsmen.
